reviews.text: This Rom&nd tint has a beautiful color and a soft, smooth texture. It feels lightweight on the lips, lasts for a long time, and gives a natural but fresh look. The tint keeps the lips moisturized and makes them look soft and glossy all day.
reviews.zh: rom&nd 呢支唇釉顏色好靚，質地柔滑。上唇好輕盈，夠持久，效果自然又有精神。用完唇部保持濕潤，成日都睇落柔軟有光澤。

reviews.text: My favorite!! This color is such a close shade to my favorite matte lipstick from Ariana Grande roller skates from her R.E.M line. This one is perfect because it’s almost the same shade but it’s a tint! Buy it! It’s amazing!!
reviews.zh: 我嘅最愛！隻色好接近我最鍾意嗰支 Ariana Grande R.E.M. 系列嘅霧面唇膏 Roller Skates。呢支好正，色調差唔多但係唇釉嚟！買啦！好好用！

reviews.text: LOVEEE the color so long lasting

I have many shades of the old formula and to be honest, I don’t find the new formula to be much different. Just a bit more lightweight and less creamy. Still a good, solid tint with a nice shade range! I got a few shades of the new formula to try. 24 Bare juicy oh is a nice apricot orange, more vibrant than Pomelo skin
reviews.zh: 舊配方我有好多隻色，老實講新配方分別唔算大，只係輕盈少少、冇咁 creamy。始終係一支好用嘅唇釉，色系又齊。新配方我揀咗幾隻試。24 Bare Juicy Oh 係好靚嘅杏橙色，比 Pomelo Skin 鮮啲。

reviews.text:
ブルベ夏イエベ春のライトの人におすすめ
意外とツヤが長持ちするし、色持ちもいいけど塗った瞬間は写真のように綺麗だけども時間が経つと赤ぽくなるからそこが難点かなー
reviews.zh: 推薦畀藍底夏、黃底春嘅淺膚色人。意外地光澤幾持久，顏色都夠持久。不過啱啱塗上去好似相片咁靚，過一陣就會偏紅，呢點係缺點。

reviews.text:
This new formulation is much thinner, I honestly like the thicker feel of the old formula better. The smell is a similar sweet smell to the original, but not the same. However this isn’t as drying as the old formula, which is a plus. 

The reason for the 3 stars is this particular color, Peach Peach Me suffers from the red/pink oxidation that happens with a lot of k-beauty lip products. It only stays the nice peach color advertised in the photos for about 10 seconds, then oxidizes into a garish deep reddish-pink fuchsia color. 

Incredibly, incredibly disappointing. I swatched it on a napkin in the picture to show the true deep saturated color that shows up, that looks nothing like the lovely advertised peach color.
reviews.zh:
新配方薄好多，老實講我鍾意舊配方厚身啲嘅質感。氣味同原本相似嘅甜味，但唔完全一樣。不過新配方冇舊配方咁乾，呢點算好。

畀三星係因為呢隻色 —— Peach Peach Me 有好多韓妝唇部產品都會出現嘅紅／粉紅氧化問題。塗上去大約十秒係相片嗰隻靚桃色，跟住就氧化成好搶眼嘅深紅粉紫色。

非常、非常失望。我喺相入面用紙巾試色，想 show 出真正顯色出嚟嘅深飽和色，同宣傳嗰隻靚桃色完全唔同。

reviews.text: love the new formula!! I was a bit worried that this shade/color would show up bright on the lips but it’s a little sheer once applied and leaves a shiny gloss! it leaves a sheer stain if wiped off 🩷 (top shade is peach peach me)
reviews.zh: 好鍾意新配方！本來擔心呢隻色上唇會好搶，點知塗上去有啲通透，仲有閃亮光澤！抹走之後會留低淡淡染色 🩷（上面嗰隻色係 peach peach me）
